messages.content: 在紐約現代藝術博物館找一座青銅雕像，並在巴黎羅浮宮找一座石頭雕像。同時，在大都會藝術博物館找一幅畢卡索的畫作。

function.name: artwork_find
function.description: Locate artwork in museums based on specific criteria like type of material, artist, or era. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

museum.description: The name of the museum, e.g. Modern Arts Museum, New York

type.description: Type of the artwork. E.g. Painting, Sculpture

material.description: Material of the artwork if it's a sculpture. E.g. Bronze, Marble

message.reasoning:

We have three function types:

- book_find: not relevant.
- historical_landmark_find: not relevant.
- artwork_find: relevant.

We need to make two calls to artwork_find: one for MoMA with type "Sculpture", material "Bronze". Another for Louvre with type "Sculpture", material "Stone" (or maybe "Marble"? But they said "stone sculpture" so we can use "Stone"). Then a third call for Met with type "Painting", artist "Picasso".

But the function signature for artwork_find has parameters: museum, type, material?, artist?. So we can pass museum: "Museum of Modern Art", type: "Sculpture", material: "Bronze". For Louvre: museum: "Louvre", type: "Sculpture", material: "Stone". For Met: museum: "Metropolitan Museum of Art", type: "Painting", artist: "Picasso".

We should produce separate function calls. According to guidelines, we should output each function call separately. The assistant should respond with JSON objects for each function call. The user asked for all three. So we will produce three separate function calls. The format: {"name":"artwork_find","arguments":{...}} etc. Each on its own line? The guidelines say "Respond with a single JSON object per function call." So we can output them sequentially. Usually we output them as separate lines. We'll do that.

Thus produce:

{"name":"artwork_find","arguments":{"museum":"Museum of Modern Art","type":"Sculpture","material":"Bronze"}}
{"name":"artwork_find","arguments":{"museum":"Louvre","type":"Sculpture","material":"Stone"}}
{"name":"artwork_find","arguments":{"museum":"Metropolitan Museum of Art","type":"Painting","artist":"Picasso"}}
